# Broker coverage

*Generated by `scripts/docgen/broker-coverage` from `internal/daemon/coverage.go`. Do not edit by hand: change the table and run `make docs-regen`.*

Canary reads one brokerage account through IBKR (TWS or IB Gateway) or through OpenD (moomoo, Futu). Most of what it shows is computed by Canary from what the broker supplies: the regime, portfolio stress, Edge and gamma are Canary's, not the broker's. So this page has two tables. The first says what each broker supplies. The second says how each capability runs on each broker and, where OpenD falls short, why. The same table decides what the daemon refuses under OpenD.

On OpenD, of 43 capabilities: 1 served, 5 partial, 19 unverified, 4 refused, 14 not served. Of those not fully served, 4 need data OpenD does not supply, 10 wait on a check of what OpenD supplies, and 7 have what they need from OpenD but are not yet read there.

## What each broker supplies

| Input | IBKR | OpenD | OpenD note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| session | supplied | supplied |   |
| account and positions | supplied | supplied | Trd_GetFunds and Trd_GetPositionList |
| intraday P&L | supplied | to verify |   |
| quotes | supplied | limited | only in markets where the login holds the quote right; a subscription quota shared with other clients of the same OpenD |
| price bars | supplied | limited | a history quota counted over seven days |
| contract lookup | supplied | supplied | Qot_GetStaticInfo |
| ISIN listings | supplied | to verify |   |
| option chains and Greeks | supplied | to verify | OpenD's snapshot carries an option's delta and implied volatility; listing a chain is not built |
| bonds | supplied | to verify |   |
| broker statements | supplied | not supplied | OpenD has no statement service like IBKR Flex |
| borrow and fee data | supplied | to verify |   |
| earnings calendar | supplied | to verify | IBKR's comes from Wall Street Horizon |
| quoted FX rates | supplied | to verify | Canary implies a rate from the account's own totals; no quoted rate is read |
| order placement and preview | supplied | supplied | Trd_PlaceOrder and Trd_ModifyOrder; the preview is a maximum quantity (Trd_GetMaxTrdQtys), not a what-if |
| order and fill history | supplied | supplied | Trd_GetHistoryOrderList and Trd_GetHistoryOrderFillList |

## How each capability runs

Statuses: *served* works and a test or live check shows it; *partial* works with the gap named; *unverified* answers, but nothing has confirmed it on that broker; *refused* is reached and answers that it cannot; *not served* is refused by the daemon before any handler runs. Why not on OpenD: *broker* means OpenD lacks a needed input, *to verify* means that is not yet known, *Canary* means OpenD supplies what it needs and Canary does not read it there yet.

| Capability | Needs | IBKR | OpenD | Why not on OpenD | OpenD note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status and data health | session | served | served |   |   |
| account | account and positions | served | partial |   | funds figures and currency conversion are tested on the simulator only |
| daily P&L | intraday P&L | served | unverified | to verify: intraday P&L | Desk's moomoo page says it is not served; it answers on the simulator |
| positions | account and positions, quotes | served | partial |   | options, futures and other holdings are listed apart and left out of exposure and limit checks; tested on the simulator only |
| quotes | quotes | served | partial |   | only in markets where the login holds the quote right |
| price history | price bars | served | unverified |   |   |
| market display | quotes | served | unverified |   | the display stream was not probed |
| market overview | quotes, price bars | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector |
| portfolio allocation | account and positions, quotes | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector |
| market tape | quotes, price bars | served | not served | Canary | joins on IBKR contract ids |
| technical analysis | price bars | served | not served | Canary | reads the IBKR connector |
| option chains | option chains and Greeks | served | not served | to verify: option chains and Greeks | reads the IBKR connector, as do the option picker and setup option discovery |
| recorded option chains | option chains and Greeks | served | unverified | to verify: option chains and Greeks |   |
| gamma | option chains and Greeks | served | not served | to verify: option chains and Greeks | reads the IBKR connector |
| bond lookup | bonds | served | not served | to verify: bonds | reads the IBKR connector |
| breadth | price bars | served | partial |   | answers from breadth already stored, still labelled IBKR HMDS, and never refreshed; what it should say on OpenD is the owner's decision |
| regime | quotes, price bars | served | refused | Canary | answers that the regime is unavailable: its broker inputs read the IBKR connector; what it should say on OpenD is the owner's decision |
| portfolio stress | account and positions, quotes, price bars | served | refused | Canary | composes from the regime, so it answers unavailable; what it should say on OpenD is the owner's decision |
| macro | no broker data | served | unverified |   | reads no broker; the simulator tests run without macro sources |
| market calendar and events | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
| brief | account and positions, quotes | served | partial |   | names what OpenD does not serve and the holdings it does not analyse |
| Edge | broker statements | served | not served | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide |
| reconciliation | broker statements | served | not served | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide |
| statement reporting | broker statements | served | not served | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide |
| FX attribution | broker statements | served | refused | broker: broker statements | built from broker statements, which OpenD does not provide, so it answers with no attribution |
| borrow availability | borrow and fee data | served | not served | to verify: borrow and fee data | IBKR's borrow and fee data |
| earnings (WSH) | earnings calendar | served | not served | to verify: earnings calendar | the earnings calendar comes through IBKR |
| cash sweep | quoted FX rates, bonds, order placement and preview | served | not served | to verify: quoted FX rates, bonds | sizes orders from a quoted ledger rate, and OpenD's rate is implied |
| cash policy | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
| core sleeve | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| core listing lookup | ISIN listings | served | not served | to verify: ISIN listings | lists the listings IBKR knows for an ISIN |
| strategy | account and positions, quotes, price bars | served | unverified |   |   |
| setups | quotes, price bars | served | unverified |   |   |
| stock add plans | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| rules, mandate and risk policy | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   | a holding in another currency without a sound rate counts as not measured |
| alerts | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| proposals | account and positions, quotes | served | unverified |   |   |
| orders | order placement and preview | served | refused | Canary | Canary does not send orders through OpenD: place and manage orders in the Futu or moomoo app |
| order history | order and fill history | served | unverified |   | order and fill history are tested on the simulator only |
| option exercise | option chains and Greeks, order placement and preview | served | unverified | to verify: option chains and Greeks |   |
| Desk authority and execution | order placement and preview | served | unverified |   |   |
| watchlist and holding locks | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
| settings | no broker data | served | unverified |   |   |
